answer_plain: Doubling hydrogen in the air raises soil hydrogen uptake over two weeks by 100 % (exactly 100 % in every case we tried), and tenfold air hydrogen increases uptake by 900 %, so uptake goes up in every case we tried. Because soil uptake in the twin is directly proportional to the hydrogen level in the air, percentage uptake rises in lockstep with air concentration.
answer_science: Central percentage change: h2_uptake_change_pct = 100 % (median 100 %, 50 % IQR [100, 100] %, joint 5–95 % interval [100, 100] %) (rounded headline: 100 %); absolute change h2_uptake_contrast_umol_m2 = 1102 µmol m⁻² (median 937.7 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [344.3, 2292] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [122.6, 4768] µmol m⁻²); absolute uptake h2_uptake_umol_m2 = 2205 µmol m⁻² (median 1875 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [688.7, 4584] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [245.2, 9537] µmol m⁻²) (mode = variance, refusal fraction = 0.0 %, max level refusal across question = 0.0 %). Because h2_uptake_change_pct is invariant across all parameter draws (ST = 0, S1 = 0), Sobol' indices are reported for h2_uptake_contrast_umol_m2. Top two Sobol' contributors to output variance: k_h2_s (ST = 0.88 [0.81, 0.96], S1 = 0.78) and retention_b (ST = 0.13 [0.11, 0.15], S1 = 0.06). Status share of variance: verified_in_source ST = 0.00 (S1 = 0.00), modeller_assumption ST = 1.01 (S1 = 1.00), source_not_checked ST = 0.00 (S1 = 0.00) (joint group total indices can sum to more than 1 because of interactions). Limits: The parameter-uncertainty interval quantifies joint variation over literature constants and twin process parameters only and excludes external-model and twin model-structure error.

limits_plain: The range shows how much the answer moves when uncertain numbers in the models are varied; the models themselves could also be wrong. At very high hydrogen levels, microbes could hit a maximum enzyme speed or grow in number, which a straight-line formula does not capture.
limits_science: The parameter-uncertainty interval quantifies joint variation over literature constants and twin process parameters only and excludes external-model and twin model-structure error. First-order Henry/diffusion-reaction kinetics in C_H2; excludes Michaelis-Menten saturation and long-term community biomass growth under elevated H₂.
